page.layout: One printed page: a woodcut royal coat of arms with supporters (unicorn left, dragon right), a scroll above reading IN MY DEFENC and GOD ME DEFEND, and a pencilled library mark below. No printed text block.
page.notes: Engraving: royal arms with a crown above, a unicorn supporter on the left and a dragon supporter on the right, a crest of a lion on a helm, and a motto scroll. The pencilled marks at the foot ("SCS # 1275") and the blue ink stain at the top are a library shelf mark and handwriting, not printed text, and are left out. The text on the scroll is partly cut off at the right edge of the scan.
